title: Kind smoke l200c: runtime change 1
summary: Add smoke/l200c-1.ts exporting kindSmokeValue() that returns the exact string "kind smoke l200c 1", and smoke/l200c-1.test.ts (bun:test) that imports kindSmokeValue and asserts that exact return value. One code commit. Nothing else in the repository changes.

nonGoals: No package.json, tsconfig, bunfig.toml, README, or .github/workflows edit
No formatter, linter, or project-wide test run (there is none configured)
No rebase unless GitHub reports the pull request CONFLICTING
No plan or spec markdown committed to the repository

CI green is a bare gate; the acceptance proof is the local bun test run at the PR head SHA.

The planner's `plan: record handoff` commit precedes the code commit on the branch; the final .legion/ deletion push removes it. This is the normal chain, not a second code commit.
